brief:
The UN migration agency has warned of mounting hypothermia deaths in Gaza while Israel continues to severely restrict the entry of shelter aid into the territory, Middle East Eye reported. Israel has barred 100,000 tents from entering Gaza, compounding conditions for displaced Palestinians facing winter weather without adequate shelter.

The restrictions on aid delivery come as Gaza faces a severe humanitarian crisis, with hundreds of thousands of people displaced and living in inadequate conditions. The UN agency's warning signals escalating concern over civilian deaths from exposure to cold as winter conditions persist.

title: Israel blocks 100,000 tents as UN warns of more Gaza hypothermia deaths
